verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party developer docs describe webhooks as a way to receive status changes for asynchronous processes instead of polling an API endpoint. That is Adyen's own outbound-callback mechanism, which the Agentic product sits on top of. However, the pack never shows webhook events specific to agentic commerce (e.g., ACP/UCP checkout sessions or token events), nor how a consumer registers an endpoint. missing for 10: documented agentic-commerce event types, webhook registration/subscription and verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
